neurons.name: stop-call
neurons.definition: the file plugins/stop, written into the output archive, meaning I am done

neurons.name: still-emitting
neurons.definition: output is still arriving, so the run is not over whatever it just wrote

neurons.name: quiet-window
neurons.definition: consecutive ticks with no output, the evidence that emitting has actually ended

neurons.name: plugins-folder
neurons.definition: plugins/ in the archive: calls I am asking the outside world to make, stopping among them

neurons.name: ceiling
neurons.definition: the tick limit that guarantees termination; hitting it means cut off, not finished

neurons.name: finished
neurons.definition: stop call seen and then quiet: the one ending where the output is whole
